title: Three-Object Glance · Together
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Three-Object Glance · Together with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Place three ordinary objects on a table and let everyone look briefly, then cover them. The lead names the three objects from memory. All three named objects match the display. Play eight turns in total, rotating the lead. The group wins together if at least five turns succeed.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: Three household objects and a cloth.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Three-Object Glance, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
All three named objects match the display.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: All three named objects match the display.

game.materials: Three household objects and a cloth
